subject.title: Heartbeat skipped reason 'target-none' is misleading when delivery is disabled by default

question: Should OpenClaw preserve the `target-none` heartbeat reason and add an additive human-readable disabled-delivery hint, or rename the reason itself?
rationale: The source repro is clear, but the permanent diagnostic contract needs maintainer intent because one option changes an exposed reason string and the safer option adds a new display/hint surface.

options.title: Add hint, keep reason
options.body: Keep `reason: "target-none"` for compatibility and add a human-facing hint/status message explaining that delivery is disabled by configuration.

options.title: Rename reason
options.body: Replace `target-none` with `delivery-disabled`, accepting a possible diagnostic contract break for consumers that parse the reason.

options.title: Leave as-is
options.body: Keep the current raw reason and rely on docs, preserving compatibility but leaving the operator confusion unresolved.

recommendation.title: Add hint, keep reason
recommendation.body: Keep `reason: "target-none"` for compatibility and add a human-facing hint/status message explaining that delivery is disabled by configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the default-none heartbeat behavior and are the strongest history signal for the diagnostic contract around that path.
